原始验收要求

新增资料并上传 PNG，保存、刷新后能预览真实图片并下载。

实际操作

  1. Opened the built app at $FACTORY_BROWSER_URL (http://127.0.0.1:13000/main/), authenticated as admin (nocobase) and navigated to /main/documents.
  2. Clicked 'New document', entered the title 'PNG 测试资料' and selected the factory fixture sample.png (99 B) on input[type=file]; the app auto-uploaded it via POST documentAttachments:uploadOne (HTTP 200) and showed 'sample.png · Done'.
  3. Submitted the dialog with a real DOM click on Save, then reloaded /main/documents.
  4. After refresh the row for 'PNG 测试资料' renders a real decoded <img alt="sample.png" src="http://127.0.0.1:13000/main/uploads/documents/<uuid>.png"> with naturalWidth=32 and naturalHeight=32.
  5. Clicked 'Preview sample.png': the preview dialog shows 'sample.png / image/png' and renders the decoded 32x32 image (not a filename placeholder).
  6. Clicked 'Download sample.png' and captured the real browser download with CDP Browser.setDownloadBehavior (Browser.downloadWillBegin/Completed), then compared the file with the fixture.

观察结果

  1. List after refresh: attachment image alt="sample.png" loads with naturalWidth=32 and naturalHeight=32 => a real PNG is displayed, not just the file name.
  2. Preview dialog title 'sample.png', type 'image/png', with the decoded image rendered.
  3. Downloaded file /tmp/qa-downloads/sample.png is 99 bytes and md5 9258d02918d8f97a3759af6ab6423973, byte-identical to the factory fixture sample.png.
  4. Upload request POST documentAttachments:uploadOne returned HTTP 200 with a real object key under uploads/documents/.

来源：verify-1/browser-acceptance/report.json · 原始状态：passed

02

为另一条资料上传 DOCX，保存、刷新后在应用内看到文档真实内容；不能以文件名截图代替预览。

环境受阻：环境受阻（agent-browser 的域限制守卫破坏了应用的 DOCX Worker）。应用本身在原生 Worker 下工作正常：用原生 Worker 构造函数运行应用同一个 DOCX 解析 Worker 会返回 {type:'documentSessionOpened',...}，应用随即渲染出真实文档文本 'Factory DOCX sample'；但只要经过 agent-browser 守卫的 bootstrap 间接层（window.Worker 或手工单层守卫，甚至不含守卫代码的纯 await import(appUrl) bootstrap），该 Worker 就静默挂起（无消息、无 error），因此应用内预览一直停留在 'Loading preview...'。最小模块 Worker（普通/自 revoke/自 revoke+顶层 await）经同样 bootstrap 均正常，说明是该应用 Worker 与守卫 bootstrap 间接层的不兼容。这是 QA 环境限制，普通浏览器不可复现；按 QA_PIPELINE 的 Worker 能力单独记录规则，不据此判应用缺陷。

A2 · 6 条操作 · 6 条观察 · 7 张证据
未验证
⌄

原始验收要求

为另一条资料上传 DOCX，保存、刷新后在应用内看到文档真实内容；不能以文件名截图代替预览。

实际操作

  1. Edited document '产品设计规范', selected the factory fixture sample.docx (975 B); the app uploaded it (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document · 975 B), saved with a DOM click and reloaded /main/documents; the row shows sample.docx.
  2. Clicked 'Preview sample.docx': the in-app preview dialog stays on 'Loading preview...' indefinitely and the real document text 'Factory DOCX sample' never appears.
  3. Captured the app's own DOCX parser worker source from the running page (30861 B module blob, type text/javascript;charset=utf-8, first line URL.revokeObjectURL(import.meta.url); wasm-bindgen) and replayed its exact message protocol {type:'init', wasmUrl} then {type:'parse', id:1,...}.
  4. Created that identical worker with the NATIVE Worker constructor (window.Worker.prototype.constructor, bypassing the guard): it immediately replied {"type":"documentSessionOpened","id":1,...}.
  5. Created the same worker through window.Worker (agent-browser guard): TIMEOUT with msgs=[] and no error; through a single manually-built guard bootstrap: TIMEOUT; and through a plain 'await import(appUrl)' bootstrap with no guard code: TIMEOUT.
  6. Control: tiny module blob workers (plain, self-revoke, self-revoke + top-level await) created through the very same bootstrap all reply normally, isolating the failure to this app worker under the indirection.

观察结果

  1. Native-created app DOCX worker: GOT {"type":"documentSessionOpened","id":1,"sessionId":1,"operationId":1,"generation":1} => the app worker is correct and responsive.
  2. Guard-created app DOCX worker: 'guarded:TIMEOUT msgs=[]' (silent, no message and no error event).
  3. Single-layer guard bootstrap: 'singleGuard:TIMEOUT msgs=[]'; plain 'await import(appUrl)' bootstrap: 'plainBootstrap:TIMEOUT msgs=[]' => the guard's worker-bootstrap indirection is the trigger, not the guard's fetch/XHR wrappers.
  4. Diagnostic native-render A/B on the live app (guard temporarily replaced with the native Worker, then reloaded) showed the real DOCX content 'Factory DOCX sample' inside the preview dialog.
  5. Guard mechanism (captured from the injected source): _workerScriptUrl() builds a bootstrap blob '(function _agentBrowserInstallDomainFilter)(...); await import("<original script URL>");' and constructs the real worker from it.
  6. Full A/B transcript saved at evidence/b02-worker-ab.txt.

来源：verify-1/browser-acceptance/report.json · 原始状态：not-verified

原始验收要求

用损坏 PNG 尝试上传及预览，在实际检测到损坏的阶段给出清晰失败，不声称预览成功；若上传阶段已拒绝，不要求继续预览。 无法实际完成时如实记录 failed、blocked 或 not_run；测试样例缺失应记录环境阻塞，不以源码检查代替浏览器通过。 同时验证案例人工输入中的产品要求： ## 本次补充要求 严格保持来源预设的小型范围：标题与附件关联、两条资料、PNG 与 DOCX 真实内容预览及一份损坏 PNG，不扩展其他格式或自建预览服务。使用工厂已准备的测试夹具；缺夹具如实记录，不让浏览器 QA 自行造文件。固定基线及既有门禁保持不变，结果关联 #249，不合并生成的业务 PR。

实际操作

  1. Edited document '项目需求说明书' and selected the factory fixture corrupt.png (28 B) on input[type=file]; the app uploaded the bytes (HTTP 200) and showed 'corrupt.png · Done'.
  2. Saved with a DOM click and reloaded /main/documents; the row shows corrupt.png (image/png · 28 B).
  3. Clicked 'Preview corrupt.png': the preview dialog shows 'corrupt.png / image/png' together with the clear failure message 'Unable to display this image. The file may be corrupted or in an unsupported format.' and a Download file action.
  4. Checked the preview dialog DOM: no <img> is rendered (naturalWidth would be 0) and there is no success affordance, i.e. the app does not claim the corrupt file previewed successfully.

观察结果

  1. Preview dialog innerText: 'corrupt.png | image/png | Unable to display this image. The file may be corrupted or in an unsupported format. | Download file | Close'.
  2. DOM query of the preview dialog returned imgs=[] => no image element/decoded preview is shown for the corrupt file.
  3. The upload stage accepted the bytes but the corrupt file is detected and reported with a clear failure at the preview stage, which is exactly what the criterion allows (no success claimed).
